Title: SITUAT-CTB-504_WEB_01
Test Run Detailed Report-07/29/2026: Verify Re-registration from WEB with all validations
column6: SITUAT/Milestone-2/HR-CTB-504 | CTB Migration Registration adaptation (Web)/WEB
column9: Verify Re-registration from WEB with all validations
column16:
1.  Open WEB URL for re-registration
2.  Enter the old credentilas and verify that user is not allowed to
    login and redirected to ‘Re-register your account’ Page
3.  Enter an invalid email ID and account combination and verify
    appropriate error message is displayed
4.  Enter valid email id and account . Proceed with registration. OTP
    verification should be sent to customer email ID
5.  Enter incorrect OTP and verify error is displayed as “The
    verification code is incorrect.”
6.  Enter an expired code and verify error “Your code has expired.
    Please request a new one.”
7.  Enter correct OTP and proceed with registration with new credentials
8.  Enter email id and invalid password credentials that Does Not meet
    below password requirement- Minimum 8 characters - At least one
    uppercase - At least one lowercase - At least one number - At least
    one special char
9.  Enter Valid email ID and Valid Password and verify if user is able
    to complete the Re registration with validations available for all
    fields for missing details. verify Digital T&Cs acceptance is
    mandatory
10. Verify user is navigated to relogin page after successful
    re-registration
11. Enter with new credentials and verify user is navigated to dashboard
    and all pre-migration account are correctly displayed.
12. Logout and try to re-register again with same email ID and account
    and verify message is displayed as “Account is already registered”.
column17:
1.  User should be redirected to ‘Register your Account’ page on
    entering old credentials
2.  Error message should be displayed when invalid email id and account
    combination is entered “We could not verify your details. Please try
    again.”
3.  OTP verification code should be sent to customer email ID
4.  When incorrect OTP is entered message should be displayed as “The
    verification code is incorrect.”
5.  when expired code is entered message should be displayed as “Your
    code has expired. Please request a new one.”
6.  When correct OTP is entered user should be redirected to New login
    credentials entry page as part of re-registration
7.  When password requirements does not meet error should be displayed
    as “Your password does not meet the required criteria.”
8.  User should be able to complete the re-registration with Valid
    details and confirmation message stating re-registration is
    successful should be displayed. Digital T&Cs acceptance should
    be mandatory to proceed with Re-registration.
9.  User should be navigated to relogin page after successful
    re-registration
10. After Successful login, user should be navigated to dashboard and
    all pre-migration account oould be displayed correctly.
11. “Account is already registered” message should be displayed when
    user tries to re-register for 2nd time

column9:

funding period and grace period.
column16:
1.  Onboard a new customer, log in to the CTB Mobile Banking
    application, and verify successful customer access.
2.  Open a new Easy Access non-ISA account for the customer and fund it
    with an amount below the product’s configured minimum balance
    requirement.
3.  Leave the account underfunded without any additional deposits until
    the funding period and associated grace period have fully expired.
4.  After the overnight batch job execution, verify from the Mobile
    Banking application that the account has been automatically closed.
5.  Verify remaining balance of a closed Easy Access non-ISA account is
    successfully transferred to the linked account upon automatic
    account closure.
6.  Verify in Clearbank that the balance transfer is completed
    successfully to the customer’s linked account.
7.  NS123 notification is generated successfully to the customer via
    Email and Letter.
8.  Log in to Salesforce, search for the party and navigate to the
    financial accounts details.
9.  Verify that the account status is displayed as Closed in Salesforce.
10. Log in to Mambu, search for the financial accounts details of the
    same party.
11. Verify that the account status is displayed as Closed in Mambu.
12. Verify closing account statement is generated for the closed account
    and the same is available in statements section for customer
    download.
column17:

    Mobile Banking application with valid credentials.
2.  A new Easy Access non-ISA account is successfully opened, and the
    account balance reflects an amount below the configured minimum
    balance requirement.
3.  The account remains underfunded throughout the funding period and
    grace period, with no additional funding activity recorded.
4.  Following the overnight batch job execution, the Easy Access non-ISA
    account is automatically closed in accordance with the configured
    business rules.
5.  The remaining available balance in the closed Easy Access non-ISA
    account is automatically transferred to the customer’s linked
    account without any loss of funds.
6.  ClearBank reflects a successful transfer transaction, and the linked
    account balance is credited with the transferred amount from the
    closed account.

    account closure details.

    accurately reflecting the account closure performed by the overnight

column6: SITUAT/Milestone-2/HR-CTB-028 - Where a customer has not specified a Maturity option for a Fixed Term Deposit the account should automatically mature into a Holding Account/AOS
column9:
Verify when an FTD account reaches maturity and the customer has not
selected a maturity option
column16:
1.  Onboard a new customer, enable CTB Mobile Banking access, and verify
    successful login and account accessibility.
2.  Open and fund a new CTB-1 day Fixed Rate E-Saver account, ensuring
    the account is active and reflects the deposited balance.
3.  Before the account reaches maturity, the customer receives the
    following two notifications: Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder
    One (NS115) and Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder Two (NS114)
4.  Allow the FTD account to reach maturity without the customer
    selecting or submitting any maturity instructions.
5.  Upon maturity, the system automatically identifies the product
    configured in the FTD’s DefaultMaturityProduct field in Mambu
    creates a new account. New account also exists in Clearbank.
6.  The accrued interest earned on the matured FTD is transferred to the
    customer’s preferred transaction account.
7.  The system transfers the entire principal balance from the matured
    FTD account to the newly created Maturity holding account.
8.  After successful fund transfers, the original FTD account is
    automatically closed with a zero remaining balance.
9.  The system sends notification NS116 to inform the customer that the
    FTD has matured, the funds have been automatically transferred to
    the new account.
10. Verify that the new account is active and the balances are
    transferred.
column17:

    account without any errors.

    account balance matches the deposited amount.
3.  Before the account reaches its maturity date, the customer should
    receive the following two notifications: Fixed Term Deposit Maturity
    Reminder One (NS115) and Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder Two
    (NS114).
4.  The FTD reaches its maturity date. No maturity instruction is found
    for the account.
5.  The system successfully retrieves the DefaultMaturityProduct
    configuration from Mambu and automatically creates a new maturity
    holding account using the configured product. This account should
    also exist in Clearbank.
6.  The accrued interest amount is successfully credited to the
    customer’s preferred transaction account. The transaction is
    recorded with the correct amount and description in Clearbank.6.The
    full principal balance is successfully transferred from the matured
    FTD account to the newly created Maturity Holding account.
7.  The original FTD account status is updated to Closed, and its
    balance becomes zero. No further transactions are permitted on the
    closed account.
8.  Notification NS116 is successfully generated and sent to the
    customer.
9.  The newly created Maturity Holding account is in Active status. The
    principal balance is available in the new account.
